articles.title: Dollar index seen well supported as soaring oil prices expedite case for a Fed rate hike
articles.description: The dollar index is seen well supported above 99 mark on Tuesday as soaring oil price are seen setting stage for a Federal rate hike in Feds upcoming policy meet. Higher oil prices have added to inflationary pressures, clouding the inflation outlook and reinforcing expectations for further Fed tightening. Oil prices extended their gains as Saudi Arabias East-West pipeline remained shut, while Ukraine disputed President Trumps claim that it had already reached an agreement with Russia to halt attacks on energy infrastructure. The yield on the 10-Year US Treasury note reached 5% on Tuesday, rising for the fifth consecutive session as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns. Brent crude climbed above $107 per barrel on Tuesday following a volatile start to the week, as investors continued to navigate heightened uncertainty over global supply. DXY is currently trading near a two-week high at 99.41, up 0.30% on the day. Among basket currencies, EUR/USD and GBP/USD are holding ...

articles.title: Hexaware Technologies stock gains 5% on Project NANDA Fellowship collaboration to advance AI agents
articles.description: Hexaware Technologies shares rose sharply on Tuesday after the company partnered with Project NANDA Fellowship, a global programme focused on developing open-source infrastructure for AI agents. The three-month fellowship will bring together developers, including Hexaware engineers, to work on agent discovery, identity and secure coordination within an open, decentralised Internet of AI Agents.

articles.title: From Rs 2 crore to Rs 50 lakh: Why Karnataka HC slashed wife's alimony
articles.description: The Karnataka high court reduced a woman's alimony from Rs 2 crore to Rs 50 lakh. It upheld the divorce, citing cruelty and marital breakdown between the couple. The court also ordered the former husband to pay Rs 50,000 monthly for their two children. Evidence was assessed by looking at the marriage as a whole, not isolated incidents. The judgment reflects the court's consideration of financial security and parties' circumstances.

articles.title: Ireland turned retired wind-turbine blades into a 6-metre bridge; engineers also reused 19th-century railway foundations instead of building anew
articles.description: Ireland's Blade Bridge offers a powerful lesson in how sustainable engineering can begin with a different question: not “What should we build?” but “What do we already have that can be used again?” A six-metre bridge may appear small compared with major roads, railways or energy projects, yet its design brings together retired renewable-energy components, centuries-old infrastructure and modern engineering research in one working structure.

articles.title: ‘Make Canada Great Again’: Mark Carney Destroys Trump’s MAGA With $120T Bid; Defies U.S. Tariff Deal
articles.description: Mark Carney has delivered a defiant economic pitch as Canada looks to reduce its dependence on the United States amid Donald Trump’s tariff pressure.Carney urged Canadians to “buy Canadian,” declared that the country is “taking control of our future,” and said some of the world’s largest investors — managing more than $120 trillion in assets — are looking at Canada differently. His “Canada Strong” message is being framed as Ottawa’s answer to Trump’s MAGA-era trade strategy.

articles.title: Centre proposes easier norms for faster grug rollout
articles.description: India's government plans to streamline drug approval processes for domestic use. Applicants can now start studies after intimating the drug regulator. Import license processing timelines for new drugs will be halved to forty-five days. This move aims to improve the ease of doing business in the sector. However, certain high-risk drug categories will retain existing stringent requirements.

articles.title: DBT transfers reach Rs 2.08 lakh crore
articles.description: Direct benefit transfers have reached ₹2.08 lakh crore this fiscal year. Fertiliser subsidy led with ₹62,984 crore, and Public Distribution System followed. Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme received ₹15,241 crore in transfers. Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin and PAHAL schemes also saw significant fund allocations. Haryana topped the state rankings for direct benefit transfers.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Alec Baldwin: 'To be in this business and have tremendous integrity and only make distinguished choices is very tough.' Life lessons from inspirational quote on immense pressure, difficulty, integrity, temptation, convenience, resilience, moral and artistic standards
articles.description: Quote of the day by Alec Baldwin explores the pressure of working in entertainment while trying to maintain integrity and professional standards. Baldwin’s saying focuses on difficulty, temptation, convenience and resilience. It explains why meaningful choices can require sacrifice and why people may need to reject easy opportunities to protect their values. His career also provides context for understanding the pressures behind the quote.

articles.title: Symbiosis Recovers 15 BTC Following Attack on syBTC Minting
articles.description: Symbiosis recovered around 15 BTC after an attacker exploited a flaw in its Bitcoin Bridge on September 11. The protocol suspended native Bitcoin routes and isolated the affected bridge while keeping other cross-chain routes operational. Symbiosis has not disclosed the total loss and is still assessing the impact on liquidity providers.

articles.title: A Tennessee farmer leased 100 acres of his century-old family land for solar rather than sell it; in 2026, the 147 MW project went live, and the lease helped keep the farm in the family
articles.description: A Tennessee farmer chose to lease family land for a solar project. This decision allows continued ownership while generating income for future generations. The Yum Yum Solar facility, a 147-megawatt project, became operational in May 2026. This lease provides a steady income stream, addressing farming challenges and land fragmentation. The project highlights a growing trend of farmers balancing energy production with land preservation.
